players.product: High-cap MLCCs (EMK/AMK series) for decoupling networks

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference First quarter for the year (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Director and Senior Executive Operating Officer Tomomitsu Fukuda (speaker notes): Q1 capacitor capacity utilization, planned in the high 80% range, fell to around 85% because of operational constraints from logistical disruptions at overseas production sites and labor-management consultations in April; without these constraints net sales would have been slightly more than 4.0 billion yen higher. The issues have been resolved, operations are normal and no impact on earnings is expected from Q2 onward.
quarterly_data.figure: capacitor utilization around 85% (planned high 80% range); slightly more than 4.0 billion yen of sales lost

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference First quarter for the year (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fukuda: capital investment forecast raised by 2.0 billion yen as the timing of capacity expansion is brought forward given the strength of AI server demand; Taiyo Yuden decided to commence construction of the new MLCC plant in Malaysia, planned under the medium-term management plan through FY2030, ahead of schedule - the plant will begin production and add capacity in the latter half of the plan.
quarterly_data.figure: capex forecast +2.0 billion yen; new Malaysia MLCC plant construction brought forward

quarterly_data.quarter: Taiyo Yuden press release: Earnings Release Conference First quarter for the year (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fukuda: capacitor orders rose across all market sectors; besides demand growth centered on AI servers, the company considers this reflects a trend toward increasing inventory levels among some customers. Cost increases from resource, metal and component prices were estimated at several billion yen in the initial forecast, unchanged.
